mapper.sql: rr.rejection_reason_id as "rejectionReasonId", rr.business_type as "businessType", rr.reason_code as "reasonCode", rr.standard_message as "standardMessage", rr.additional_opinion_allowed_yn as "additionalOpinionAllowedYn", rr.change_reason as "changeReason", rr.updated_by as "updatedBy", rr.updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
select from rejection_reasons rr
order by rr.business_type, rr.reason_code limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into rejection_reasons (business_type, reason_code, standard_message, additional_opinion_allowed_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{businessType}, #{reasonCode}, #{standardMessage}, #{additionalOpinionAllowedYn}, #{changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (business_type, reason_code) do update set standard_message = EXCLUDED.standard_message, additional_opinion_allowed_yn = EXCLUDED.additional_opinion_allowed_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason})
